_this_file_is: THE ONE SHIPPED EXAMPLE. It exists to demonstrate every field of the site-profile format against example.com, the domain IANA reserves for documentation, so it annotates nothing on the real web. KS4Web ships no starter profiles: every claim in a profile is a factual assertion about somebody else's site, and a wrong one is worse than a missing one because the user believes it. Copy this file into your own profiles directory, rename the file and the slug together, and point it at a site you have actually looked at.
_keys_beginning_with_underscore: are ignored by the loader, so a profile may carry its own commentary.

match._path_prefix_note: Rename this key to 'path_prefix' to narrow a profile to part of a host. It is left inert here because a profile that claims a path prefix outranks one that does not, and a shipped example must never outrank a user's own file.
